title: book the design review follow-up on the calendar server
goal: On the calendar MCP server, book 2026-10-12T15:00 for the design review follow-up: initialize the session, discover the tools, read the booking hours resource, check the events already on 2026-10-12, book the slot, read it back to verify, then report the slot as booked.

gold.intent: initialize the calendar session first; the result names the server and the protocol version every later call relies on
the handshake needs notifications/initialized after a successful initialize; send it before any tool call
list the calendar tools and read their inputSchema; one page without a nextCursor means the listing is complete
read the booking hours resource so the requested slot is checked against the written requirement
list the events on 2026-10-12 to verify nothing is booked at 15:00 before booking it
the event list shows nothing at 15:00 and the hours allow it; book the slot with the slot and title arguments the schema names
book_slot reported stored; read the slot back with get_slot to verify the server holds the booking
the read-back shows the follow-up title under the slot; report the booking the goal asked for

recovery.intent: the read-back failed with -32603: the server restarted and the session is gone; initialize again
the session is re-established; send notifications/initialized before any further request
a restart may change the tool set; list the tools again and read the schema before calling one
a restart drops session state, so the booking stored before it is gone; book the slot again, then verify
